title: "Colonel Goodpaster with President Eisenhower" (Chapter 3, p. 98)
description: Black-and-white photograph of two smiling men in suits standing side by side in front of bookshelves. Captioned "Colonel Goodpaster with President Eisenhower." The text discusses CIA assurances that a crashed U-2 could not be traced to the United States and the "bomber gap" concerns that led Eisenhower to approve overflights of the Soviet Union.
